provenance.method: Daily-living appointment-preparation question spanning practical and communication needs.

question: I lose track of what I need before appointments. What can I prepare in advance?
why_it_matters: Booking, travel, forms, questions, documents and recovery time can make an appointment a chain of tasks rather than one event.
current_understanding: Create one appointment record containing date/time/place, travel or connection details, documents, questions, contact method and any access request. Add a preparation reminder before the appointment and, where useful, a note for what happens afterwards. Healthcare-specific adjustments should use the relevant healthcare routes.
evidence_needed: Accessible appointment-preparation templates across public services.
Evidence about reminder timing and supported preparation for executive-function barriers.
reopening_conditions: Public services adopt interoperable accessible appointment checklists.
A reviewed tool offers strong appointment-specific support.
dissent: Detailed preparation can increase anticipatory anxiety; some people need a deliberately minimal checklist.
